title: 阅读器的视觉方向
question: 随机分配到「发车时刻表」方向。保留它、换成备选，或重新抽一手。

options.label: Departure Timetable · 发车时刻表
options.lineage: printed railway timetables and station departure boards
options.thesis: Every book is a departure, and its time is already in the title: Before Dark, At Dawn, Past Noon, On Sunday.
options.viewport: Ink sidebar set as a 55-row timetable (No. / time / destination), an ink board above the column with the chapter as a route line of stops, and a calm 66-character English column with Chinese beneath.
options.risk: Becomes a costume if board styling leaks into the reading column; a few titles (Hurry Up Houdini) carry no time and need an honest blank.

raised.raise: All colour is spent in one place: signal yellow marks only where you are and what you kept.
State is a mark, not a tint: current stop is a filled dot, a kept sentence carries a yellow tab, a revealed line a rule.
Stops are numbered in one strict system shared by the route line, the timetable and the pager.
Only-favourites becomes an express service that stops at kept sentences only.

options.label: Parallel-Text Edition · 对照本
options.lineage: bilingual classics editions with facing translation
options.thesis: English set as the primary text; Chinese as the quiet facing translation in the margin.
materials: running heads and margin line numbers
options.viewport: A cloth-coloured running head, sentence numbers in a margin column, English column left and Chinese facing it on the right.
options.risk: The familiar destination: bookish serif on pale paper is where most reading apps land.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.thesis: An achromatic white reading field where colour lives only as a thin spectral fringe at the edges.
options.viewport: Wide white margins, slate body ink, a mint-rose-violet hairline along the sidebar edge and under the current chapter.
options.case: Holds reading clarity (colour never touches the text) but nothing in it belongs to this series.
options.risk: Pretty and anonymous: could be any reader app.

options.label: Civic Bureau Prospectus
options.thesis: Bone-white plate, one rendered ribbon, one violet button.
options.case: A persuasion page, not a reading surface.
options.risk: Turns a book into a brochure.
options.kept: All colour spent in one place.

options.label: Cutting-Bench Select Rail
options.thesis: A perforated rail of frames with a tape flag where you stopped.
options.viewport: Orange field with a perforated rail.
options.case: Too loud for long desk reading; the tool reads as costume.
options.kept: State is a mark, not a hue.

options.label: Orizuru Fold Sequence
options.viewport: Vermilion ground with a numbered margin column.
options.case: No tie to the series; vermilion ground fights the text.

options.label: Hand-Drawn Zine
options.thesis: Marker headings, doodle arrows, highlighter swipes.
options.case: Childish for an adult reader; mascots compete with the text.
options.kept: Highlight only the line that matters.

options.label: Raygun Layout Desk
options.case: Breaks the reading order by design; wrong for immersive reading.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean e-reader: white page, grey sidebar, system type, one blue accent.
canonCard.viewport: Book list sidebar, centred reading column, toolbar on top.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any reader app by design.
